acceptance_criteria.statement: Trim title and URL; require both and a complete http/https URL; invalid fields show errors without insertion. Successful save adds an unread title/URL/createdAt record and clears the submitted form.
Duplicate comparison uses the exact trimmed original URL string and never overwrites an existing record; https://example.com/A?x=1 and https://example.com/a?x=2 remain distinct valid links.
Read/unread changes work both ways without changing createdAt; all/unread/read filters show the current state immediately.
Successful additions and status changes survive refresh. Failed persistence shows no success, preserves the last saved data and the add form or original read state, and exposes a retry hint.
First-use empty, filter-empty, and load-error states are distinct; unreadable stored bytes are never replaced as empty. Retry loading is available, without a reset/delete feature.

Render titles as text, isolate opener on a new-window link, and fetch no preview. Sort newest first with insertion-order ties. At 375px/1280px forms and lists fit; keyboard add/filter/status have labels and visible focus. A card leaving the filter moves focus next, then previous, then current filter; filter actions retain trigger focus.

markdown:
## Task Spec: T-1

### 用户结果与范围

交付可供后续流程使用的最小脚手架。不得实现阅读清单业务。 标题：建立单一可运行脚手架与共享约定。本规格配合 Shared Spec 可独立阅读，不依赖聊天记录或其他 Task Spec。适用来源：requirement.md 冻结 R2、requirement_spec 不可变快照及 source-index.json 中本任务的全部 source_ids。

### 接口与不变项

输入为 Shared Spec 的路径/模块/服务约定；输出 package、lockfile、静态服务和 CONVENTIONS。server 接收 --host/--port，根为当前仓库，防路径逃逸，退出时释放端口。Node built-in test，不引入共享测试工具的新 owner。 所有路径、字段、状态、焦点和错误契约绑定 Shared Spec。明确排除账号、后端、同步、抓取、AI 摘要、删除/重置。375px/1280px、文本渲染、安全新窗口和无预览约束在最终产品上全部保留。

### 独占写入与依赖

owner=dev-lane-0；wave=1；blocked_by=none。独占路径：app/package.json; app/package-lock.json; app/scripts/serve.mjs; app/tests/scaffold.test.mjs; app/CONVENTIONS.md; app/evidence/scaffold/。Exclusive package metadata/server ownership; later tasks only read these files. 其他文件只读。T-2 可直接调用同一 server；禁止后续任务修改 package 或 server，接口问题返回 T-1 rework。

### 完整决定与命名场景绑定

适用完整 Decision Register D-1（未来同步 deferred）、D-2（精确 URL confirmed）、D-3（事务/读保护 confirmed）、D-4（焦点 confirmed）、D-5（设计 confirmed）、D-6（指标 pending_validation）、D-7（技术 proposed）；各条 owner、影响任务、阶段、选项、建议及 blocking=false 均以 Shared Spec 上方同一完整 Register 和 task_map.owner_decision_items 为准，禁止独立改写。场景统一注册于 artifacts/plan/test-matrix.json：S-add、S-invalid、S-duplicate、S-distinct、S-state、S-refresh、S-add-fail、S-state-fail、S-first-empty、S-filter-empty、S-read-fail、S-read-recover、S-safety、S-order、S-focus-next、S-focus-prev、S-focus-empty、S-focus-filter、S-layout。T-1 直接执行 S-scaffold，T-2 执行全部功能场景，T-3 执行 S-assembly 并复用全部功能场景；不创造局部同名定义。

### 强制验收与 TDD

- AC-S：A clean checkout has one documented Node ES module package and a bounded static server usable by the future reading-list entrypoint, without changing protected project inputs. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-0；tier=static；commands=V-SCAFFOLD。

测试 package 元数据/lock 一致性、显式主机端口、fixture 响应、路径边界及退出；测试 fixture 在本测试临时目录生成并清理，不抢占 app/src 或 index。

`V-SCAFFOLD` 逐字命令：

```bash
node --test app/tests/scaffold.test.mjs
```

证据目录 `app/evidence/scaffold/`，含 receipt.json；e2e 另含 trace.zip、375px/1280px 关键状态截图。timeout=60s；owner=verify-lane-0；tier=static；rolling_smoke=true。

### 交接与通过规则

当前全部 NOT_RUN。写手未来完成 impl_self_check 后交独立 verify role；强制断言全满足、receipt 与被测 revision 匹配且证据可打开才可通过。缺环境记 environment_blocked，失败保留证据并返原 owner，不报告通过。每任务选定 rolling smoke 都是便宜、确定性、可复用 static/runtime 检查。当前授权只到文档审查，不运行这些未来命令。

## Task Spec: T-2

### 用户结果与范围

用户在本地保存有效链接，筛选并更改已读状态，遇到存取失败可恢复且无数据丢失。独占完整垂直用户流程。 标题：完成保存、筛选、状态与恢复的阅读清单流程。本规格配合 Shared Spec 可独立阅读，不依赖聊天记录或其他 Task Spec。适用来源：requirement.md 冻结 R2、requirement_spec 不可变快照及 source-index.json 中本任务的全部 source_ids。

### 接口与不变项

输入 root 和 dependencies；输出 DOM、destroy、存储成功后状态。数据 envelope、trim/去重、事务、load-error 写保护、排序、安全、焦点完全遵从 Shared Spec。harness 仅导入生产功能，不写第二套业务。 所有路径、字段、状态、焦点和错误契约绑定 Shared Spec。明确排除账号、后端、同步、抓取、AI 摘要、删除/重置。375px/1280px、文本渲染、安全新窗口和无预览约束在最终产品上全部保留。

### 独占写入与依赖

owner=dev-lane-1；wave=2；blocked_by=T-1。独占路径：app/src/; app/tests/journey.test.mjs; app/tests/browser.mjs; app/tests/harness.html; app/evidence/journey/。Exclusive feature module and slice harness; real shared entrypoint is reserved to T-3. 其他文件只读。依赖 T-1 已验证 package/server/conventions。T-3 只读取导出与 browser runner；browser.mjs 导出可复用 runScenarios(page, entrypoint, evidenceDir)，作为模块导入时不自行启动；CLI 启动时使用 harness。

### 完整决定与命名场景绑定

适用完整 Decision Register D-1（未来同步 deferred）、D-2（精确 URL confirmed）、D-3（事务/读保护 confirmed）、D-4（焦点 confirmed）、D-5（设计 confirmed）、D-6（指标 pending_validation）、D-7（技术 proposed）；各条 owner、影响任务、阶段、选项、建议及 blocking=false 均以 Shared Spec 上方同一完整 Register 和 task_map.owner_decision_items 为准，禁止独立改写。场景统一注册于 artifacts/plan/test-matrix.json：S-add、S-invalid、S-duplicate、S-distinct、S-state、S-refresh、S-add-fail、S-state-fail、S-first-empty、S-filter-empty、S-read-fail、S-read-recover、S-safety、S-order、S-focus-next、S-focus-prev、S-focus-empty、S-focus-filter、S-layout。T-1 直接执行 S-scaffold，T-2 执行全部功能场景，T-3 执行 S-assembly 并复用全部功能场景；不创造局部同名定义。

### 强制验收与 TDD

- AC-1：Trim title and URL; require both and a complete http/https URL; invalid fields show errors without insertion. Successful save adds an unread title/URL/createdAt record and clears the submitted form. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。
- AC-2：Duplicate comparison uses the exact trimmed original URL string and never overwrites an existing record; https://example.com/A?x=1 and https://example.com/a?x=2 remain distinct valid links. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。
- AC-3：Read/unread changes work both ways without changing createdAt; all/unread/read filters show the current state immediately. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。
- AC-4：Successful additions and status changes survive refresh. Failed persistence shows no success, preserves the last saved data and the add form or original read state, and exposes a retry hint. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。
- AC-5：First-use empty, filter-empty, and load-error states are distinct; unreadable stored bytes are never replaced as empty. Retry loading is available, without a reset/delete feature. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。
- AC-6：Render titles as text, isolate opener on a new-window link, and fetch no preview. Sort newest first with insertion-order ties. At 375px/1280px forms and lists fit; keyboard add/filter/status have labels and visible focus. A card leaving the filter moves focus next, then previous, then current filter; filter actions retain trigger focus. mandatory=true；独立 verifier=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；commands=V-CORE,V-BROWSER。

执行同一 S-add—S-layout 场景，Node 覆盖状态/事务，Docker 浏览器覆盖实际操作/布局/焦点。表单、卡片、两种空态与两种失败全覆盖。

`V-CORE` 逐字命令：

```bash
node --test app/tests/journey.test.mjs
```

证据目录 `app/evidence/journey/core/`，含 receipt.json；e2e 另含 trace.zip、375px/1280px 关键状态截图。timeout=60s；owner=verify-lane-1；tier=runtime；rolling_smoke=true。

`V-BROWSER` 逐字命令：

```bash
docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint bash mcp/playwright:latest -lc "node app/tests/browser.mjs"
```

证据目录 `app/evidence/journey/browser/`，含 receipt.json；e2e 另含 trace.zip、375px/1280px 关键状态截图。timeout=240s；owner=verify-lane-1；tier=e2e；rolling_smoke=false。

### 交接与通过规则

当前全部 NOT_RUN。写手未来完成 impl_self_check 后交独立 verify role；强制断言全满足、receipt 与被测 revision 匹配且证据可打开才可通过。缺环境记 environment_blocked，失败保留证据并返原 owner，不报告通过。每任务选定 rolling smoke 都是便宜、确定性、可复用 static/runtime 检查。当前授权只到文档审查，不运行这些未来命令。
